description: Tsitsani mtundu wovomerezeka kuti muyambe kucheza, kapena sakatulani Hub kuti mupeze ina.
checkEngineGpuUnused: {{backend}} ndi CPU-yokha, kotero {{gpus}} azikhala osachita chilichonse. Sankhani GPU kumbuyo kwa Zochunira kuti mugwiritse ntchito.
checkEngineVendorMismatch: {{backend}} ikufunika {{vendor}} GPU, koma Novera yapezeka {{gpus}}. Novera iyamba pa CPU.
checkEngineRuntimeUnreachable: {{backend}} singafike ku GPU, kotero Novera idzayamba pa CPU. Izi nthawi zambiri zimatanthauza kuti GPU dalaivala kapena nthawi yoyendetsa amafunika kusinthidwa.
checkEngineMissingLibrary: {{backend}} singayambe chifukwa laibulale yofunikira ikusowa ({{libraries}}), kotero Novera idzayamba pa CPU.
checkEngineProbeFailed: Sizinathe kutsimikizira kuti injini ikhoza kugwiritsa ntchito GPU
checkEngineUnavailable: Makina opangira injiniwa sangathe kunena za GPU
checkSearchNoVector: Mtundu woyika sunabweretse zotsatira, chifukwa chake kusaka kwamafayilo sikugwirabe ntchito
checkSearchInvalidVector: Mtundu woyika wabweza zotsatira zosagwiritsidwa ntchito, kotero kusaka kwamafayilo sikungabweretse chilichonse
checkSearchUnavailable: Kumanga kwa injini iyi sikungatsimikizire mtundu woyika
welcomeTitle: Novera ikufunika kukhazikitsa pa makina anu
welcomeBody: Izi zimatenga mphindi zingapo: Novera kutsitsa injini yake yachidziwitso ndi kachitsanzo kakang'ono kakusaka mafayilo. Mukhoza kupitiriza kugwiritsa ntchito kompyuta yanu pamene ikuyenda.
setupDoneBody: Novera idzayendetsa mamoloko am'deralo ndi llama.cpp.
dsparkDescription: Tsitsani mnzake wa DSpark Q8_0 ({{size}}) wa LFM2.5-2.6B. Ikhoza kufulumizitsa kupanga, koma imagwiritsa ntchito zowonjezera RAM kapena VRAM, kusiya kukumbukira kocheperako pamutuwu. Yesani pa hardware yanu; sinthani kutalika kwa nkhani kapena kuletsa kumasulira kongopeka muzokonda zachitsanzo.
